scope: experimental only; previously observed development and regression
proposal: Frozen calibrated layout M_D_1.0; fixed whole donor and positive isotropic transform
training: Only original train characters; three folds assigned by sha256(layout-risk-v1:+character) modulo 3 across writers; rebuild v4 and retained-source profiles from other folds; public task selection before target scoring; mean repeats within character
examples: Only actually changed M versus D proposals; one outcome per writer/character; safe benefit iff geometry ratio <1, every stroke max error increase <=0.005 and character mean terminal angle increase <=0.5 degrees
features: public position/extent/stroke count, D-to-public center/scale, M-to-D center/scale, empirical band distance and effective strength, exact-tier flag, nearest disjoint public leaf relation residual and proposed relation change; no gold features
learner: IQR-scaled RMS neighbor distance with scale floor0.1, exclude query character across all writers before scaling, closest up to8 within distance2, require5; accept only safe fraction>=threshold and mean geometry ratio<1
selection: user001 existing development only; strictly improve mean geometry vs D, angle <=D+0.5deg, each character <=1.05D, each stroke max increase <=0.005, fixed donor; prefer lowest geometry then author scope then highest threshold; otherwise D
regression: existing user001 test and scx/mjb/wsq cohorts; no new validation claim; ungated M always shown; no character exceptions or retuning
limits: Crossfit proposals use two-thirds of each author's training archive; inference uses original full train profiles. This distribution shift and sparse changed proposals limit risk estimates. Safe fraction is not a calibrated probability of naturalness.
